description: This file defines the RouteResolver class within the Slim Framework, responsible for resolving routes and computing routing results based on URIs and HTTP methods.

classes.name: RouteResolver
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving routes and dispatching routing results within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the route collector and dispatcher.

methods.name: computeRoutingResults
methods.description: Decodes the URI, ensures it starts with '/', and dispatches it using the dispatcher to obtain routing results.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Looks up and returns a specific route by its identifier.
